items.title: A foldable iPhone is nice, but Apple still needs to improve its AI user experience
items.summary: Apple (AAPL) is expected to unveil its foldable iPhone on Wednesday at its "Surprise and Shine" event. This will be CEO John Ternus's first product launch as chief executive. Sherwood News head of markets Luke Kawa and Investopedia editor in chief Caleb Silver chat with Morning Brief host Julie Hyman about their expectations for the launch.

items.title: Verizon and Corning Just Signed an 80 Million Mile Fiber Deal to Wire the AI Boom
items.summary: Corning just locked in a supply deal with Verizon that stacks on top of agreements already signed with Meta, Amazon, and NVIDIA, and the market is treating the two sides of this transaction very differently.

items.title: Why Does AT&T Stock Still Trade Like It Is Shrinking?
items.summary: AT&T (T) trades at 8.2 times earnings against an S&P 500 median of 23.0, and it got there the hard way: the stock returned -9.4% over the past year while the index returned +19.3%. A profitable telecom throwing off cash at that discount is what value buyers hunt for.

items.title: Why Corning Stock Keeps Going Up
items.summary: One single sales contract with Verizon may have just made Corning stock a buy.

items.title: How a 74-Year-Old Collects $8,900 a Month Without Selling a Single Share
items.summary: Collecting $8,900 a month in retirement without selling shares sounds clean until you see what the biggest position in this seven-ticker setup actually pays when markets go quiet.

items.title: Why Is Corning (GLW) Stock Rocketing Higher Today
items.summary: Shares of glass and electronic component manufacturer Corning (NYSE:GLW) jumped 8.7% in the afternoon session after the company announced a multi-year, multi-billion-dollar supply agreement with Verizon through 2032 to deliver optical fiber and connectivity solutions.

items.summary: Crude oil pushed toward $100 per barrel amid Middle East conflict and U.S.-Canada trade friction, today, Sept. 8, 2026.

items.title: AMD, Amgen, Novartis, Qualcomn, Corning, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: FEATURE  Stocks declined on Tuesday as oil prices rose, renewing investor worries about hotter inflation and bolstering the case for the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates. Investor attention may turn to Apple on Wednesday when the company holds its iPhone launch event.
